verdict.rationale: Groq is an API-first inference service. It offers a REST API, a server-side TypeScript SDK, API-key authentication and an asynchronous Batch API, so it runs headlessly and can be scripted for automation by its nature. Nothing documents CI usage specifically. Missing for 10: CI/CD integration docs or examples, an official CLI for pipeline use, guidance on non-interactive secrets/env-var setup, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: This library provides convenient access to the Groq REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
Batch processing lets you run thousands of API requests at scale by submitting your workload as an asynchronous batch of requests to Groq
pass your Groq API key to the api_key parameter and change the base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
